operations.console_note: Archived Sessions (docs/session-archive.md): the swipe's 封存 on a row (`session/List.tsx`) and the sidebar's Archive page (`pages/archive.tsx`). The archive rides the Session's own channel, as `end` does; the list is a machine read and the restore a machine command under the press's key.
The capacity block on Settings (`pages/settings/CapacityBlock.tsx`), which every capacity push names: a machine read with no parameter.

A page's own failures, delivered by the copied client with nobody pressing anything once a row is recorded (`cloud-viewer-events.js`); a failed carried read is one (`cloud.read.failed`, `relay-reader.ts`).

operations.console_sentence: This machine does not take a diagnostic report over Clawdline Cloud.
Dispatching a task over Clawdline Cloud has no pinned wire shape on this machine: dispatch it on the machine.

decode.hand: its body is open: every field is accepted, and a body naming no request still decodes
the scope decides whether a task segment exists, and the session must equal the plan's own reply session

operations.console_sentence: A waiting card's press is sent as `answer`, which names the question it answers; `key` is the older spelling of the same command.
operations.console_note: `key` and `answer` are one command under two names on the wire. This console sends a waiting card's press as `answer`, because only that spelling carries `expect`, the fingerprint of the question the press was chosen for (F1, `RelayWriter.press`). `key` is the older spelling and is deliberately never sent.
The dashboard behind the session counts (`machine/`): CPU, memory, disk space and grouped reclaim backlog, a machine read with no parameter.

decode.hand: the machine id in its query is the bridge's own, set after decoding, not a body field
its header is read into agenthandoff.Request and sent re-encoded, so the local body is that type's spelling

operations.console_note: The built-in personas a start may name (docs/personas.md): a machine read with no parameter. A machine that does not list it is refused by the copied client before anything leaves (`_unsupportedRefusal`).

Project settings sync (docs/project-sync.md). The two source reads are also asked of *another* paired machine by `cloud/project-sync.ts`, which is how a mirror reads its source without either machine reaching the other.
The 「Claude 與 Codex 共用」 block in Project settings (`pages/projects/ProjectUnify.tsx`, docs/project-files.md §Unify): the plan is a read, and apply carries the press's Idempotency-Key.
Account quota snapshots for the global footer. Credentials remain on the machine.

decode.hand: an optional cloud_subscription_id is merged into the subscription object, refusing a clash

operations.console_note: The sessions a reboot took away (docs/session-restore.md), offered where the empty session list stands (`session/Restore.tsx`). The read is the machine's; the two commands carry the sheet's press key as their request.

decode.hand: the path spells a default assistant only when a persona needs one, and orders its segments by what was named
its request_id is the answer's request and a UUID, with no session field, and replace_hook_id is sent as null

operations.console_note: The live screen (`session/ScreenPanel.tsx`). It sat in `DEFERRED` and in `DEFERRED_ASKED` while this machine answered it, so 「即時畫面」 on a phone only ever said to go and look on the machine — including from the Waiting card that sends a person there to read the question.
An opened waiting Session whose question has not come asks for its one row (`relay-reader.ts` askForOpenedQuestion), when the machine advertises it.

No console route asks this: the copied client does, on every connection that did not take over a live socket (`_recoverSessions`), so a list opened after a relay eviction is sent every row rather than whichever changed.
The Shell panel (`session/ShellPanel.tsx`): the tail of one background command's output, polled while the panel is open.

decode.hand: the path spells a default assistant only when a later segment needs one, and orders its segments by what was named

operations.console_note: The Settings page's update panel and the list's banner (`machine/update.ts`): whether this machine trails the latest build, a machine read with no parameter.
The Settings page's 「立即更新」 (`machine/UpdatePanel.tsx`): install the newest release of the machine's channel, a machine command with no body.

The token bill (`pages/work/TokenBill.tsx`). Machine reads, not session reads: a conversation id is the ledger's key and not a row this page holds. Whether compacting early paid (docs/token-ledger.md "Did compacting early pay"): a machine read with its one query field.
Whether handing over paid (docs/token-ledger.md "Did handing over pay"): the same one query field. No page asks it yet; `clawdline usage --compare-handoff` does.

The raw samples a before/after report is folded from (docs/token-ledger.md "Did a change make one unit of work cheaper"): a machine read with its two query fields. No page asks it yet; `clawdline usage --work-report` does.
What each unit of work added (docs/token-ledger.md "One unit of work").

Things waiting to be verified (`pages/verify.tsx`, docs/verifications.md): the phone is where the person reads them, so every route crosses. Two machine reads and five commands, each with its body as the route reads it.
